claim: Patchline ships cloud-provider integrations gating managed-database schema changes before they apply. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the cloud-provider integration claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make cloud-provider-integration-gate`.
